policy: Every on-demand CLI fallback used by aggregate proof must be pinned, lockfile-backed, schema-checked, generically validated, runner-nested-shape-proven, schema-uniqueness-proven, ci-preflight-proven, poison-tested, proof-asset-declared, prove-command-executed, and read from this manifest before execution.

tools.purpose: P12 AST rule twin proof for resilience-lint and anti-slop-ui.

proof.description: Run all configured ast-grep rule twin fixtures.

tools.fallback_policy: Use the lockfile-backed local binary first, then a temp npm-ci install from the lockfile, then the manifest-pinned npx package_spec.
tools.safety_policy: Do not execute unpinned package specs, package aliases, or lockfiles whose resolved tarball and integrity disagree with this contract.
